data_description.host: The IP address of your Sky Hub.

legacy_known_devices.description:
Sky Hub now creates its own device tracker entities, but the following entries left over from the old YAML setup still exist in `{path}` for devices tracked by the router at `{host}`:

{devices}

These legacy trackers can conflict with the new entities and prevent them from updating.

Remove these entries from `{path}` and restart Home Assistant.
legacy_known_devices.title: Remove leftover known devices for Sky Hub

yaml_import_cannot_connect.description:
The YAML configuration for Sky Hub at `{host}` could not be imported because the connection failed.

Check that `{host}` is reachable, update your `configuration.yaml` if needed, and restart Home Assistant.
yaml_import_cannot_connect.title: YAML configuration import failed: cannot connect
